# اِسْتَبْرَأْتِ (istabraʔti) /is.tab.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اِسْتَبْرَأَتْ (istabraʔat) /is.t
